Get heritage objects (erfgoedobjecten)

get_oe_erfgoedobjecten.Rd

`get_oe_erfgoedobjecten()` get an OGC Simple Features collection containing the heritage objects of the Flemish Inventory of Immovable Heritage (Inventaris Onroerend Erfgoed). The data is downloaded from https://geo.onroerenderfgoed.be/downloads. The coordinate reference system is EPSG:31370.

Usage

get_oe_erfgoedobjecten(layer = "erfgoedobjecten")

Arguments

layer

Layer to be returned from the downloaded zip file. Default value is 'erfgoedobjecten'. Other values are 'landschappelijk_gehelen', 'landschappelijk_elementen', 'bouwkundig_elementen', 'bouwkundig_gehelen', 'archeologie_elementen' and 'archeologie_gehelen'.

Value

An object of class sf (see st_read). The object has a comment containing the retrieval_time and retrieval_url.

Examples

get_oe_erfgoedobjecten()
#> Simple feature collection with 92699 features and 13 fields
#> Geometry type: MULTIPOLYGON
#> Dimension:     XY
#> Bounding box:  xmin: 22071.41 ymin: 153165.5 xmax: 258866.5 ymax: 243901.5
